시편-136-1.title: 시편 136장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-136-1.exegesis: 19-21. (Compare Psa 115:9-11 ). There we have "trust" for "bless" here.
시편-136-1.theologicalNote: 19-21. (Compare Psa 115:9-11 ). There we have "trust" for "bless" here.

시편-136-2.title: 시편 136장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-136-2.exegesis: PSALM 136 Psa 136:1-26 . The theme is the same as that of Psalm 135. God should be praised for His works of creation and providence, His deliverance and care of His people, and judgments on their enemies, and His goodness to all. The chorus to every verse is in terms of that of Psa 106:1 ; 118:1-4 , and was perhaps used as the Amen by the people, in worship (compare 1Ch 16:36 ; Psa 105:45 ). 1-3. The divine titles denote supremacy.
